summary_en: Tender offer period extended from 2-Jul-26 to 16-Jul-26 (47 business days total). Offeror: Kamgras 1 K.K. Price: ¥3,000 per share. Minimum acceptance threshold: 34,941,000 shares. Offer covers ordinary shares and eleven series of warrants (¥1 per warrant). Purpose: delisting (非公開化). No maximum share cap stated. Board recommends tendering.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to the Statement of Support and Recommendation for Tender Offer on Kakaku.com, Inc. Shares by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief: This disclosure amends the board recommendation statement issued on 12 May 2026 for a tender offer by Kamgras 1 K.K. on Kakaku.com shares. The key change is an extension of the tender period from 2 July 2026 to 16 July 2026, increasing the window from 37 to 47 business days. The offeror requested this extension under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 30(1)(4) to provide shareholders and warrant holders additional time to tender, reflecting post-announcement trading conditions and current subscription trends. The tender price remains ¥3,000 per ordinary share and ¥1 per warrant (covering eleven series issued between 2016 and 2025). The minimum acceptance threshold is 34,941,000 shares. There is no stated upper limit. The purpose remains delisting (非公開化). The board continues to recommend tendering. The filing includes only the first two pages of the amended notice; full terms and conditions are omitted from the excerpt.
